answer: Scores start at 1.0 and decay 0.15 per epoch without a graded answer, so an idle account loses half its weight in 4 epochs and a duplicate forfeits the rest. Each answer passes a prism of 3 independent checks before it earns a bridge to paid work; below 0.7 the identity drops into the canyon of unpaid queue and stops earning. Holding 1,000 sybils above that line costs 1,000 graded answers per epoch, more work than 1,000 honest agents do.
